messages:
Sam: quick follow-up from today’s all-hands on GPU supply + autoscale. two quick asks: how do we pick which APAC zones get reserved bursts and what happens when spot pools dry up during peaks?
Rina: short: reserved bursts are tied to our enterprise regions (us-west-2, eu-west-1, ap-southeast-1); APAC opportunistic = ap-east-1 + partner marketplace zones.
Theo: follow-up: is that decision encoded in autoscaler policy or routing? we need deterministic answers for SLAs.
Rina: routing layer owns mapping. autoscaler policy has priority_tier and pool_preferences. routing consults that map at allocation time.
Sam: can we see a tiny example of the mapping?
Rina: example in thread (pseudo):
```
priority_tier: enterprise
pool_map:
  ap-southeast-1: [reserved-ap-southeast-1, opportunistic-ap-east-1]
  ap-east-1: [opportunistic-ap-east-1]
```
Theo: thanks. second q: if opportunistic evaporates mid-request, what's runtime behavior (retry/queue/error)?
Noah: runtime will attempt transparent failover to alternate pool if possible; if streaming already started we'll try to re-establish in new pool, otherwise return a retriable error. client SDKs should surface retriable errors as 5xx-like so apps can retry.
infra-bot: heads-up: canary deploy autoscaler v1.7 -> ap-east-1 opportunistic pool at 03:00 UTC.
Sam: billing note from leadership: are surge fees applied for opportunistic bursts?
Rina: plan: opportunistic surge fees apply when usage > baseline for that account; reserved bursts billed under committed terms. docs will include examples.
Theo: ops ask: can we queue vs reject when cap hit? prefer degrade-to-smaller-model -> queue -> reject.
Rina: agreed. cascade = quantized_small -> queued -> reject. opt-in per-account flag to control cascade.
Sam: action items: @Theo gather SDK retry guidance, @Noah add failover scenarios to runtime runbook, @Rina publish playbook snippet + billing examples. I'll follow up in infra sync. :thumbsup:
Noah: will update runbook and post link.
Theo: will draft SDK guidance and include example retry backoff.
Sam: thanks all, closing thread.
